column1: When I try to think and speak in English, {{c1::my mind suddenly goes blank}}. I can't help but remain silent.
column2: my mind goes blank — đầu óc đột nhiên trống rỗng

column1: As I ran away from the dark alley, I heard {{c1::someone's voice trail off}} behind me.
column2: someone's voice trails off — giọng nhỏ dần rồi ngừng lại

column1: {{c1::For all we know}}, getting eight hours of sleep a night could be exactly what keeps us mentally healthy. You can't {{c1::talk me into sleeping less than that}}, and you'd probably {{c1::be better off doing the same}}.
column2:
for all we know — biết đâu / với những gì ta biết thì có thể
talk someone into + -ing — thuyết phục ai làm gì
be better off + -ing — sẽ tốt hơn nếu làm gì

column1: I {{c1::hit a bump}} while working on the problem and couldn't figure it out. After a while, {{c1::I figured that}} it {{c1::had nothing to do with}} what I'd been working on—I was tackling the wrong problem.
column2:
hit a bump — gặp trở ngại
I figured (that)... — tôi nghĩ / đoán / kết luận rằng
have nothing to do with + noun/-ing — không liên quan gì đến

column1: The building looked so {{c1::run-down}} that we decided to repaint it and repair the walls.
column2: run-down — xuống cấp, cũ kỹ, tồi tàn

column1: I {{c1::stick up for her}} because she's {{c1::determined to work things out}} before everything turns ugly. You're just {{c1::making a fuss about it}} without actually solving anything.
column2:
stick up for someone — bênh vực ai
be determined to + verb — quyết tâm làm gì
make a fuss (about/over something) — làm ầm / làm quá chuyện gì

column1: {{c1::The prospect of becoming a teacher}} sends chills down my spine. Just a couple of months ago, I didn't know what to do with my career because programming wasn't fun anymore and AI was already doing a lot of the work.
column2: the prospect of + noun/-ing — viễn cảnh / khả năng sẽ làm gì
